title: Home recovery and reliable updates
details: Existing Milos users with legacy local data are migrated past the hidden onboarding gate that could block the home menu
The Milos face now has a direct mobile pointer route into the existing menu action
Installed Milos shells now stay on one complete version until an update is installed, preventing new HTML from mixing with older cached JavaScript
Milos now shows a visible installed-version message and future Update available notices
